'''Moppo Dop''' was a burly professional [[Gulliball/Legends|gulliball]] player. A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]], he accused [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]] of cheating during the [[Big Nasty Free-For-All]].
